title: Put back
purpose: Return picked specimens of a request to storage, keeping them allocated or releasing them.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators. Release from the request is offered to managers and administrators only. It opens in a wide dialog that can be maximized.

sections.title: The grid
paragraphs: One row per picked specimen of the request that is not in a packed shipment; specimens in a packed shipment are listed above the grid (unpack the shipment first). Free positions are suggested above the grid; nothing is reserved.

A row marked Already in storage is a picked specimen that was checked in from the specimen record after it was picked. It has no box, position or thaw entry: ticking it records the put back against the check-in already made, moves nothing and checks nothing in again.

items.label: Put back
items.description: Tick each specimen to put back.

items.label: Box, Position
items.description: Required for a ticked row in hand (not for Already in storage): choose the box and type the position label, for example A1. The position is checked again when you save.

items.label: Thaw observed while out
items.description: Yes, No or Not known (the default). Leaving storage is not a thaw; record only what was observed.

items.label: Custodian after check-in
items.description: Required: the operating staff member recorded as putting them away; you by default.

items.label: Release them from the request
items.description: Managers and administrators: the allocations and their holds are released so the specimens can be allocated again. Unticked, they stay allocated to the request.

items.label: Put back at
items.description: Required; repository local time, not in the future.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: Each ticked specimen in hand is checked in to its position (an ordinary check-in); a specimen already in storage is recorded as put back without a new check-in. Either way it leaves any draft shipment it was in and stays allocated, or is released with Release them from the request. Nothing is saved if any line is refused.
